name: node_modules
description: Dependencies for Node.js / JavaScript projects. Can be safely reinstalled via npm/yarn/pnpm install.
action: Run 'npm clean' or re-install dependencies if needed.

name: target
description: Cargo build output for Rust projects. Can be regenerated with 'cargo build'.

name: build
description: Compiled binaries and build output for CMake, Gradle, Swift or Python projects.

name: DerivedData
description: Xcode intermediate build products, indexes, and symbol caches.
action: Quit Xcode and remove DerivedData or manage via Xcode Settings ▸ Locations.

name: Caches
description: Temporary application caches (Homebrew, npm, pip, browsers, Spotify, etc.).
action: Quit application and clear cache via app preferences or Finder.

name: .Trash
description: Files currently in your macOS Trash.
action: Empty Trash in Finder (Finder ▸ Empty Trash).

name: Installers
description: Downloaded disk images (.dmg), packages (.pkg), or OS firmware images (.ipsw).
action: Delete disk image if installation is already complete.

name: Python Environment / Cache
description: Python bytecode (__pycache__), virtualenvs (.venv), or pytest/mypy caches.
action: Safe to delete; bytecode is regenerated automatically on execution.

name: Pods
description: CocoaPods dependency workspace. Can be regenerated via 'pod install'.
action: Run 'pod install' if dependencies are needed again.
